add_reference_variable.rationale: Sets reference variables that resolve to other services' values, changing runtime configuration.

connect_service_source.rationale: Connects a service to a GitHub repo or Docker image, establishing a standing deployment trigger from an external source.

create_bucket.rationale: Creates an object storage bucket. Billable.

create_environment.rationale: Creates an environment, optionally forked from an existing one.

create_service.rationale: Creates a service, optionally wired to a repo or image.

create_tcp_proxy.rationale: Creates a public TCP proxy, exposing a service port to the internet.

create_volume.rationale: Creates and attaches a persistent volume. Billable.

delete_domain.rationale: Irreversibly deletes a custom or service domain.

deploy.rationale: Uploads a code tarball and starts a deployment. Runs arbitrary code in the environment.

deploy_template.rationale: Deploys a template, provisioning billable services.

disconnect_service_source.rationale: Disconnects a service from its source, breaking the deployment pipeline.

docs_fetch.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): fetches a Railway documentation page.

domain_status.rationale: Pass-through (read): current status of an existing resource.

environment_status.rationale: Pass-through (read): current status of an existing resource.

generate_domain.rationale: Adds a service or custom domain, publishing the service at a new address.

get_logs.rationale: Pass-through (read): build, deploy, or HTTP logs, which may echo application data.

get_service_config.rationale: Pass-through (read): service configuration. Reports a variable count, not variable values — contrast list_variables.

get_tcp_proxy.rationale: Pass-through (read): current status of an existing resource.

http_error_rate.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): aggregate traffic and performance metrics.

http_requests.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): aggregate traffic and performance metrics.

http_response_time.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): aggregate traffic and performance metrics.

link_environment.rationale: Re-targeting. Switches the linked environment, so a later approved deploy or set_variables that omits explicit IDs can land somewhere other than the approver pictured.

link_service.rationale: Re-targeting. Switches the linked service for subsequent CLI-defaulted calls.

list_variables.rationale: Credential disclosure, and the one read kept governed here. Returns variables as KEY=VALUE, which routinely hold live credentials for systems outside Railway — database URLs, payment keys, cloud access keys. Escalates a Railway-scoped token into third-party access MPAS does not govern.

private_network_status.rationale: Pass-through (read): current status of an existing resource.

private_network_update.rationale: Renames the private networking endpoint, redirecting service-to-service traffic.

remove_bucket.rationale: Irreversibly removes an object storage bucket and its contents.

remove_service.rationale: Irreversibly removes a service, per its own description.

remove_tcp_proxy.rationale: Irreversibly removes a public TCP proxy, cutting external access to the service.

remove_volume.rationale: Irreversibly removes a persistent volume and its data.

retry_domain_certificate.rationale: Re-runs TLS certificate issuance for an existing custom domain. Creates no resource.

scale_service.rationale: Changes replica counts across regions, up to 50 total. Cost and availability event.

search_templates.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): searches Railway's public template catalogue.

service_metrics.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): aggregate traffic and performance metrics.

set_variables.rationale: Sets environment variables on a service and triggers a redeploy. Injects secrets and changes runtime behaviour.

update_domain.rationale: Changes a domain's target port or renames a service domain, redirecting public traffic.

update_service.rationale: Changes build command, start command, cron schedule, and pre-deploy command — arbitrary code execution paths in the service.

update_volume.rationale: Changes a volume's name or mount path. A mount-path change can orphan existing data.

whoami.rationale: Pass-through (read): current status of an existing resource.
